privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: ANTEI is a bring-your-own-key AI gallery. This policy explains what we store, what leaves our servers, who processes it on our behalf, and the control you have over it.

sections.heading: What we store
sections.body: We keep as little as the product allows and no advertising profile of any kind.
items: Account details from Clerk when you sign in: an identifier, your email address, and any name or avatar you chose there.
Generation records: prompts, model and provider chosen, parameters such as seed and resolution, timing, and success or failure.
The files you generate or upload, and the collections, canvases and LoRA recipes you build from them.
Credit balance and deduction history where a model runs on platform credits.

A record of each assistant turn: the canvas at the time, the steps it took and the model it used (never the key itself), kept for troubleshooting and replay testing and never included in shares or exports.
Support messages you send us, and error reports (see «Error monitoring»).

sections.heading: Your API keys
sections.body: Keys you connect are stored encrypted and used only to reach the provider you connected them for. We do not read them, resell capacity through them, or use them for our own generation. You can remove a key at any time, which stops it being used immediately.

sections.heading: What we send to AI providers
sections.body: When you generate, the prompt and any reference material for that job are sent to the provider you selected, for example OpenAI, Google, fal.ai, ByteDance, ElevenLabs or Fish Audio. What they do with it is governed by their own policies, and some providers retain inputs for a period for abuse monitoring. We do not send them your account email or your archive.

sections.heading: What you make public
sections.body: Works you make public, together with your display name, avatar and bio, can be seen by anyone, including visitors who are not signed in and search engines. A work’s prompt is shown only if you separately choose to make the prompt public. When you switch a work back to private we stop showing it, but we cannot recall copies others have already saved.

sections.heading: Service providers we use
sections.body: We rely on a small set of companies to run ANTEI. They process data on our instructions and only for these purposes:
items: Clerk: authentication and account records.
Neon: the application database.
Cloudflare R2: storage and delivery of your generated and uploaded files.
Vercel: hosting and request serving.
Sentry: error and performance monitoring.
The AI providers you connect or select, for the jobs you run.

sections.heading: Where your data is processed
sections.body: These providers operate in several countries, so your data may be processed outside where you live, including outside the EEA and the UK. Where that happens we rely on the transfer safeguards those providers offer, such as standard contractual clauses.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
sections.body: Files and generation records stay until you delete them or close your account. When you close an account we delete your files and records; backups holding copies roll off within 30 days. Credit and payment records are kept as long as accounting rules require. Assistant turn records are kept for 30 days, and only your latest 200. Error reports are kept for up to 90 days.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
sections.body: We use cookies that keep you signed in and hold your language choice. We use no advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. The browser also stores some workspace state locally, such as canvas layout, panel sizes and drafts, which never leaves your device and clears when you clear site data.

sections.heading: Error monitoring
sections.body: Sentry receives a report when something breaks: the error, the page, browser and version, and an account identifier so we can tell whether one person hit a problem or everyone did. Reports can include the URL you were on. We do not send prompts or generated files into error reports.

sections.heading: Session replay
sections.body: Session replay (Sentry Session Replay) reconstructs what happened in the interface before a problem: clicks, navigation, console and network activity. It is off until you accept it in the privacy banner, and you can withdraw consent by clearing this site's data. All text is masked and all media blocked before anything is sent, so prompts, generated images and file names are never captured. We sample 1% of sessions and keep a replay for up to 90 days, alongside the matching error report.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Wherever you live, you can ask us to do the following, and we answer within 30 days:
items: Get a copy of the data we hold about you.
Correct anything inaccurate.
Delete an individual result, a whole collection, or your entire account.
Export your files and generation records.
Object to or restrict a particular use of your data.
Complain to your local data protection authority if you think we got it wrong.

sections.heading: Children
sections.body: ANTEI is not intended for children under 13, or under 16 in the European Economic Area and the United Kingdom, and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you believe a child has created an account, write to xiuruisu@gmail.com and we will remove it.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: Traffic is encrypted in transit, files are stored in access-controlled buckets, API keys are encrypted at rest, and access to production data is limited to what operating the service requires. No system is perfectly secure; if a breach affects your data we will notify you and the relevant authority as the law requires.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We update this policy as the product and its processors change. The date at the top reflects the current version, and we give notice in the product before a material change takes effect.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Data questions, access requests and deletion requests: xiuruisu@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms cover your use of ANTEI. By creating an account or using the service you agree to them. If you do not agree, do not use ANTEI. What may be published to the gallery is set out in the Content Guidelines.

sections.heading: The service
sections.body: ANTEI is a personal gallery for generating images, video, audio and 3D assets with multiple AI models, and for keeping every result in one archive. Generation runs either through your own provider API keys or through platform credits, depending on the model. Which models are available changes as providers add, retire and reprice them.

sections.heading: Who may use ANTEI
sections.body: You must be at least 13 years old, or 16 if you are in the European Economic Area or the United Kingdom, and old enough to enter a contract where you live. Mature content features are restricted further; see the mature content section below. If you use ANTEI on behalf of an organisation, you confirm you are authorised to accept these terms for it.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: Sign-in is handled by Clerk. You are responsible for the activity under your account, for the keys and credentials you connect, and for keeping your sign-in details secure. Tell us promptly if you believe someone else has access.

sections.heading: Keys, credits and payment
sections.body: Where you connect your own API key, you contract directly with that provider and pay them at their rates; we do not resell their capacity and cannot control their pricing. Where a model runs on platform credits, credits are deducted server-side when a job is accepted.
items: A job that fails before a provider accepts it does not consume credits.
A job that a provider runs and returns is charged even if you dislike the result.
Credits have no cash value and are not transferable between accounts.
Provider prices shown in the product are indicative and can change without notice.

sections.heading: What you may not generate or upload
sections.body: Some limits are absolute and apply regardless of which model or key you use. Do not use ANTEI to create, upload or distribute:
items: Sexual content involving minors, or any material that sexualises a person under 18, whether real or generated and in any style.
Sexual or intimate imagery of a real, identifiable person made or shared without their consent.
Impersonation of a real person or organisation intended to deceive, defraud, or influence an election.
Content that harasses, threatens or incites violence against a person or group.
Material that infringes someone else's copyright, trademark, likeness or other rights.
Malware, credential-harvesting material, or content designed to defeat security or age controls.

sections.heading: Mature content
sections.body: ANTEI can surface and generate adult material where a model and its licence permit it. That material is for users aged 18 or over who are of age in their jurisdiction, and remains subject to the prohibitions above without exception. Using it is a statement that you are of age where you live. Mature content stays in your own library and cannot be made public: the gallery and ANTEI’s own pages are for all ages.

sections.heading: Your content and your outputs
sections.body: You keep the rights you already hold in the prompts, reference images and files you bring. As between you and us we claim no ownership of what you generate. We need a limited licence to run the service: to store your files, transmit them to the provider you selected, and display them back to you in your archive, canvas and any surfaces you choose to publish. When you make a work public, you agree that anyone can see it: it appears in the ANTEI gallery and on your creator page, and we may feature it on ANTEI’s own pages, such as the homepage, without payment. You can switch a work back to private at any time, and we will take it down from those places within a reasonable time. We cannot recall copies that others have already saved or shared.

sections.heading: Model and LoRA licences
sections.body: Models, checkpoints and LoRAs reached through ANTEI carry their own licences from their authors, including the ones listed from public libraries. Some forbid commercial use, some forbid certain subjects, some require attribution. Those terms bind you directly, and we cannot grant you rights their authors did not.

sections.heading: Third-party providers
sections.body: Generation happens on infrastructure we do not operate. Your prompt and any reference material are transmitted to the provider you selected for that job, and their terms and policies apply to that processing. Provider outages, content filters and model changes are outside our control.

sections.heading: Reporting and takedowns
sections.body: If something on ANTEI infringes your rights or depicts you without consent, write to xiuruisu@gmail.com with the location of the material and enough detail to identify it. We remove material that breaks these terms and act on valid infringement notices. We may reinstate material if a complaint turns out to be unfounded.

sections.heading: Suspension and termination
sections.body: We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms, and we will act immediately and without notice where content in the absolute-prohibition list is involved. You can close your account at any time. On closure we delete your stored files and generation records; see the privacy policy for what survives and for how long.

sections.heading: Availability and changes
sections.body: ANTEI is provided as-is and as-available. We work to keep it running but do not promise uninterrupted service, and we may add, change or withdraw features and models. Where a change materially reduces what you already paid for, we will say so in advance where we reasonably can.

sections.heading: Disclaimers
sections.body: Generated output is produced by statistical models and can be wrong, offensive, or resemble existing work. We do not warrant that output is accurate, original, or fit for any particular purpose, and we do not review what you generate before you see it. Judgement about whether an output is safe to publish or use commercially is yours.

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: To the extent the law allows, we are not liable for lost profits, lost data, or indirect or consequential loss, and our total liability for any claim is limited to what you paid us in the three months before it arose. Nothing here limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited, including for death, personal injury, or fraud.

sections.heading: Indemnity
sections.body: You agree to cover our reasonable costs if a third party brings a claim against us because of content you generated, uploaded or published through ANTEI, or because you used the service in breach of these terms.

sections.heading: Governing law and disputes
sections.body: These terms are governed by the law of the operator’s principal place of business, and disputes go to the courts there. If you are a consumer, mandatory protections and courts available to you where you live are unaffected. Talk to us first at xiuruisu@gmail.com; most issues are faster to fix than to litigate.

sections.heading: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We update these terms as the product changes. The date at the top always reflects the current version. For material changes we give notice in the product before they take effect; continuing to use ANTEI afterwards means you accept them.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about these terms, takedowns, your account or your data: xiuruisu@gmail.com.

guidelines.title: Content Guidelines
guidelines.intro: These guidelines explain what you can do on ANTEI and what you can make public. They supplement the Terms of Service; where the two differ, the Terms of Service apply.

sections.heading: Your library is yours; the gallery is everyone’s
sections.body: What you generate and upload stays in your own library by default, where nobody else can see it. When you make a work public it appears in the ANTEI gallery and on your creator page, and it may be featured on ANTEI’s own pages, such as the homepage. Public means anyone can see it; if you don’t want it seen, don’t make it public. You can switch a work back to private at any time, and we will take it down from those places.

sections.heading: Never allowed, anywhere
sections.body: Whether public or not, whichever model or key you use, the following may not be generated, uploaded or shared on ANTEI:
items: Sexual content involving minors, or anything that sexualises a person under 18, real or generated, in any art style.
Sexual or intimate imagery of an identifiable real person made or shared without their consent.
Content that impersonates a real person or organisation to deceive, defraud or influence an election.
Content that harasses or threatens a person or group, or incites violence against them.
Malware, credential theft, and anything meant to get around safety or age restrictions.

sections.heading: What can be published to the gallery
sections.body: The gallery and ANTEI’s own pages are for all ages. Public works may not contain the following. Where the Terms of Service allow it, such content can stay in your own library; it just cannot be made public:
items: Nudity or sexual content, including strongly suggestive poses or clothing.
Gory or cruel violence, or real images of death or injury.
Content that promotes hatred of, or discrimination against, a group.
Content that promotes self-harm, suicide or drug use.

sections.heading: Real people
sections.body: Public works should not show an identifiable real person unless it is you, or you have that person’s consent. This applies to public figures too.

sections.heading: Other people’s work, characters and LoRAs
sections.body: Drawing characters you love and making fan works is fine, but don’t pass yourself off as the original creator or bring in someone else’s work as your own. Models, base models and LoRAs carry their authors’ licences: some forbid commercial use, some require credit, and those licences bind you directly. When a rights holder asks us to take something down, we will.

sections.heading: Images made with search
sections.body: Works generated with Google Search turned on are for your eyes only and cannot be made public. This is Google’s requirement for such images, and the product blocks it.

sections.heading: Posting elsewhere
sections.body: Your works are AI-generated. When you post them on other platforms, label them as AI-generated wherever local law or that platform requires it.

sections.heading: Reporting and enforcement
sections.body: If you see content that breaks these guidelines, or someone has used your work or your likeness without consent, email xiuruisu@gmail.com with a link to the work. Depending on the case we take the work down, warn the author, or close the account for serious or repeated violations. Anything under “Never allowed, anywhere” leads to closure without notice.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: We update these guidelines as the product changes. The date at the top reflects the current version.

headline: Say it once.
She does the rest.
me: A ginger cat curator in round glasses at a museum front desk, warm light
A girl in an off-white coat with a black book. Try a few styles
Three lines for tonight’s show: a woman, a boy, a narrator
A 30-second short: rain, two people, one umbrella
Can someone else keep me company today?
What do you think of this one?
v6.sys: ANTEI is taking a break. Little Whale is here.

shots: Done! The second one looks most like a curator. Just a little grumpy~
lora: New styles? Leave it to me!
Same her, four styles! Secretly the line art one is my favourite.
voice: All voiced! I read the narrator three times till I liked it. Go listen!
canvas: Done! The hydrangeas in shot three are my favourite~
char: Sure, I’ll go get Little Whale~
…Mm. I’m Little Whale. Slow talker. Fast drawer.

script: He tilts the umbrella her way.

char.whaleQuote: …Mm. It sits so steady. Like a rock in the sea. I like it.

lineup.title: She picks the model
lineup.sub: You just say it. She decides which one.
lineup.guide: …I pick which one. Linger on one to see what it’s made.
lineup.loraSub: Not a model. It rides on one.

gpt.pro: A long, detailed brief where nothing can be missed. Editing, too.
gpt.con: When you’re in a hurry or need a lot at once. It’s slow, and it costs more.
gpt.say: …For a long list of asks, it’s the one I trust.

gemini.pro: Editing. What you didn’t ask to change stays put, and faces stay recognisable.
gemini.con: Big changes, like day to night or merging pictures. The seams show.
gemini.say: …For edits I go to it. It leaves the rest alone.

seedream.pro: Text and layout in the picture. Posters, signs, Chinese lettering.
seedream.con: Small, dense text like infographics. The fine print goes wrong.
seedream.say: …Any lettering on a poster, I hand to it.

novelai.pro: Anime. Several characters in one frame without their looks bleeding together.
novelai.con: Photos or realism. It only draws anime, and it needs your own NovelAI subscription.
novelai.say: …For anime, I play favourites. This one.

lora.pro: When the same person has to look the same every time, or you’ve settled on a style.
lora.con: It only fits its own family of models. Switch families and it won’t load.
lora.say: …It isn’t a model. It’s how I remember a person, or a style.

seedance.pro: Shots where someone speaks. The lips match, and the sound comes with it.
seedance.con: Long takes. Past a dozen seconds, the lips start to drift.
seedance.say: …When someone has to talk, I go to it.

wan.pro: One shot that has to run long. Orbit, push in: it follows the camera.
wan.con: Dialogue that needs lip sync. It sometimes cuts on its own, too.
wan.say: …For one long take, I go to it.

minimax.pro: Working from references: the person, the camera move, the voice. Sharpest picture, too.
minimax.con: Big motion and physics. Seedance does that better.
minimax.say: …When you have references, I go to it.

fish.pro: Reading lines. Write the emotion right into the line, and clone a voice.
fish.con: One very long read needs tuning in parts, and the stock voices are fewer than elsewhere.
